methods.copy: CPU packing into pinned buffer, then actual H2D DMA and native attention in one stream; local HBM is aliased without gathering
methods.direct: Native attention directly reads mapped Host DRAM
methods.overlap: Fused attention overlaps in-kernel Host reads with local computation

timing.gpu_cycle: GPU events inside CUDA graph; every iteration includes its H2D DMA for copy and attention; CPU packing excluded
timing.cold_single: One GPU cycle after 64 MiB L2 eviction
timing.serial_wall: CPU wall time for one serialized cycle, including CPU packing for copy and final synchronization
timing.cpu_pack: CPU gather into the pinned staging buffer
